purpose: Qualify the sealed V9 composite runtime in six short AEE closed-loop cases before any 90-case comparison.

approval.scope: One immutable six-case Gate-6 readiness run: tunnel/garage x V9 seeds 0/1/2 x 180 seconds, environment seed 11.
approval.confirmation_reference: Standing authorization for in-scope choices and formal runs without repeated approval.

raw_sources: Sealed V9 ROS deployment export with three checkpoints, seal SHA-256 a99ea047246643ed7293dc2fe0d40406a528cc0e0b15b5167307ab70697b3205.
AEE tunnel and garage development worlds in the frozen planner-seed-v1-runnable image.
Frozen M-TARE simulator, LiDAR, terrain, localPlanner, pathFollower, control and host lossless bag finalizer.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local closed-loop research qualification using existing project development environments.

sampling.rule: Six predeclared closed-loop case units; retain every message on the frozen topic contract for exactly 180 simulation seconds after the first valid global waypoint. The 5m fields are acceptance minima, not pre-observed outcomes.

teacher.source: No teacher, GT map or objective label enters the planner. V9 uses learned current-scan direction, frozen current-scan B0 count and fixed count-to-role semantics.
teacher.valid_mask: Every planner cycle must have finite synchronized sensor/pose input; every V9 trace records B0 count/role provenance and direction fallback.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: Only current/past sensor observations and trace-verified traversals drive the causal graph and waypoint. Future poses, C09/C10 and complete-map oracle are excluded.

split.historical_pollution_audit: Only AEE tunnel/garage development worlds and environment seed 11 are used. Seed 11 is predeclared as the first frozen development seed without result inspection.

method.main: V9 learned direction + always-on frozen B0 count + fixed role, causal graph and deterministic topological frontier planner through the unchanged M-TARE local planning/control stack.
method.baseline: The earlier unadapted Gate-6 case is sealed failure evidence only and is not rerun or selected against.
method.necessary_fallback: B0 supplies direction only when learned direction is empty; each use is audited and post-warmup rate must be <=5%.

estimated_cost.compute: Six serial Gazebo/ROS CPU cases, 1080 total simulated seconds; zero training/GPU.

evidence.machine_metrics: Six case contracts, logs, lossless bags, topic audits, trajectories, graph snapshots, decision traces, fallback/composite audits, metrics, aggregate RUN_STATE and seal.
evidence.complete_visual_review: Trajectory, graph and waypoint artifacts are retained per case; formal decision is machine-gated.
evidence.failure_policy: Any case failure stops the immutable run and seals FAIL; no retry, seed/world deletion, threshold change or C09/C10 read.
